title: The dimension at a point is unchanged on an open subspace
statement: Let $Y$ be a topological space, $O\subseteq Y$ an open subset with the subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology] and $y\in O$. Then the Krull dimension of $O$ at $y$ equals the Krull dimension of $Y$ at $y$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]: $\dim_y(O)=\dim_y(Y)$.

source.place: Topology, Section 'Krull dimension', Definition 0055 (label definition-Krull, line 1392, part (4): dim_x(X) = min of dim(U) over open neighbourhoods U of x) and the remark after it (line 1421: 'if U' subset U subset X are open then dim(U') <= dim(U). Hence ... x has a fundamental system of open neighbourhoods U with dim(U) = dim_x(X)')
